nodes.text: As of today, January 6, 2025, India has confirmed five cases of Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV) across three states. Two cases were reported in #Karnataka, one in #Gujarat, and two in #TamilNadu  . All these cases involve children. The Indian Council of Medical Research (#ICMR)

nodes.author: anaveentalks
nodes.text: In #Karnataka, the cases include a three-month-old female infant who has been discharged and an eight-month-old male infant currently under treatment for bronchopneumonia. In #Gujarat, a child in #Ahmedabad was admitted to a private hospital. The Tamil Nadu cases consist of two children, one from #Chennai and one from #Salem, both currently stable and being monitored.

nodes.author: anaveentalks
nodes.text:
Government and Expert Response
The Indian government and health experts have urged calmness, emphasizing that #HMPV is not a new virus and resembles regular flu. Union Health Minister JP Nadda in a video message stressed that #HMPV has been circulating globally for years. There's

nodes.text:
Public Health Measures
Preventive measures advised include covering the mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, frequent handwashing, and avoiding public places if symptomatic. State governments in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Kerala have issued advisories to stay vigilant but have reassured the public not to panic.

nodes.author: anaveentalks
nodes.text:
Ongoing Surveillance
The #ICMR will increase the number of laboratories testing for #HMPV and plans to monitor its trends throughout the year to ensure effective management of respiratory illnesses. #Health #Vigilance #Infection
